game_concept: A survival strategy set in The Kingdom – Postern Gate, the hidden postern gate: the squire must handle rogue crows while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Reassign Relay: Overwrite a variable with a fresh value each round so the old number vanishes before rogue crows can use it.
theme: The Kingdom – Postern Gate: the hidden postern gate
core_gameplay_loop: In Postern Gate, repeat each round: Overwrite a variable with a fresh value each round so the old number vanishes before rogue crows can use it. Each round, rogue crows strike the market bell, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the wave_target value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the market bell from rogue crows in Postern Gate: keep the wave_target meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 67-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: wave_target drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 67-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 7 (applied tier): Reassign Relay
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Reassign Relay' (Week 1 slot 2), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Postern Gate'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how wave_target changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crows in Postern Gate.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 67 seconds while wave_target > 0.
